_about: Fixes proposed on the Fix the errors screen (docs/specs/M3.md, section 3). Key: check id, or check id and part (5.6-cdtr); a part key wins over the id key. action: a function in js/fix/actions/ (header of each file). field: the label on the screen and in the email. note: a short explanation on the screen. changesPayment: true for a calculated change that changes what the payment does (proposed, not ticked). Ticked are only calculated changes without changesPayment. options/default: the values of a choice. sample: the marked placeholder for missing data. check: how a typed or chosen value is checked (js/fix/checks.js). element: the element to change, below the finding's element; up: it may also be on the payment block. manual: no change, the text says what to do instead. A check without an entry is manual. Information (severity I) is never fixed; its entries matter only if a setting raises the severity.

2.1.manual: Put the element where the ISO schema expects it, in the system that creates the file.

2.2.manual: Add the missing element in the system that creates the file.

2.3.manual: Remove the extra occurrences of the element in the system that creates the file.

2.4.manual: Correct the spelling or the namespace of the element, or leave it out, in the system that creates the file.

2.5.manual: Give exactly one of the options the schema allows, in the system that creates the file.

2.6.field: Text shortened to the length the schema allows
2.6.note: The first characters are kept. Only names and free texts are shortened, never ids or codes; an empty element stays open.

2.7.field: Value written in the form the schema requires
2.7.note: Capitals for BIC, IBAN, country, currency and LEI; no spaces in the IBAN; small letters for the UETR. NbOfTxs is counted again.

2.9.field: Control sum, added up again from the amounts
2.9.note: Only the control sum is worked out again. Amounts are never changed.

2.10.note: Only dates with one clear meaning: 25.11.2026, 2026/11/25 or 20261125 become 2026-11-25.

2.11.field: true or false written in small letters

2.x.manual: Correct the element so that it matches the ISO schema, in the system that creates the file.

3.1.manual: Choose one of the countries offered and check the file again.

3.2.manual: Check the file for the country of the debtor account, or pay from an account in the selected country.

3.3.manual: Check the file for the country of the debtor's bank, or use the BIC of the bank in the selected country.

3.4.manual: Send one file per country: move the payment blocks of each debtor country into a file of their own.

3.5.manual: Give the creditor's IBAN, the BIC of the creditor's bank or the creditor's country, in the system that creates the file.

3.6.manual: Send the payment as a type the country offers, or check the file for the country where it is offered.

3.7.manual: Put the payments of each type into payment blocks of their own, in the system that creates the file.

4.1.note: Type the message id the customer's system gives this file. It must be unique for each file.

4.2-future.field: Creation date and time (CreDtTm), set to now

4.2-age.manual: Create the file again, and check that an old file is not being sent again.

4.6.note: Made from the message id and the block number.

4.9.manual: Use payment method TRF. A cheque (CHK) or transfer advice (TRA) cannot be turned into a credit transfer here.

4.10.note: Today, or the next business day if today is not one. SEPA Instant payments: today.

4.11.manual: Choose an execution date within the allowed horizon, in the system that creates the file.

4.12.field: Requested execution date without the time (Dt instead of DtTm)

4.13.field: Payment type information of the transaction, the same as its block's (removed)

4.14.field: Charge bearer of the transaction, the same as its block's (removed)

4.16.manual: Use an active ISO 4217 code for the debtor account currency (DbtrAcct/Ccy), or leave the currency out.

4.17.note: Type the BIC of the bank that holds the debtor account.

4.18-account.field: Charges account agent without a charges account (removed)
4.18-account.note: Or add the charges account in the system that creates the file.

4.18-agent.manual: Use a charges account at the debtor's bank or one of its branches.

4.20.note: NOTPROVIDED means the customer gives no reference. The value is used for every place.

4.21.manual: Every transaction needs an amount greater than zero. Amounts are not changed here.

4.22.manual: Write the amount with as many decimals as the currency has. Amounts are not changed here.

4.23.manual: Use an active ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR, USD or CZK.

4.24-currency.manual: Use an active ISO 4217 code as currency of transfer (EqvtAmt/CcyOfTrf).

4.24-supported.manual: Give the amount as an instructed amount (InstdAmt) in the currency of the transfer.

4.25-unit.manual: Give the exchange rate for a currency of the transaction, or leave the unit currency out.

4.25-contract.manual: Add the id of the FX contract (XchgRateInf/CtrctId), or use another rate type.

4.26.manual: Add the creditor's bank (CdtrAgt) with its BIC, in the system that creates the file.

4.27-member.field: Clearing member id (MmbId) without spaces or separators

4.30-missing.note: Only for addresses that have a country. An address without a country stays open.

4.30-unstructured.manual: Give the town (TwnNm) and the country (Ctry) of the address in their own elements.

4.30-lines.manual: Keep at most 2 address lines, or move their content into StrtNm, BldgNb and PstCd.

4.30-repeat.manual: Remove from the address lines what StrtNm, PstCd or TwnNm already give.

4.31.manual: Add the creditor's IBAN or account number in the system that creates the file.

4.33.note: Or use a supported instruction code in the system that creates the file.

4.37-proprietary.manual: Use a local instrument code of the ISO list instead of the proprietary value, or leave it out.

4.38-combined.manual: Give the remittance information either unstructured (Ustrd) or structured (Strd), not both.

4.38-count.note: The lines are joined with a space, if they fit into 140 characters.

4.39.note: Type the reference exactly as the creditor gives it.

5.1.field: Text with characters that are not allowed, replaced
5.1.note: Letters get their plain form (é → e). & becomes +, _ becomes -, @ becomes (at), € becomes EUR; other characters become a space.

5.2.field: Text written in plain Latin letters, as CMIplus would do it
5.2.note: For example é → e, ß → ss.

5.3.field: Text with tabs or line breaks replaced by a space

5.4-spaces.field: Text with spaces at the start or end

5.4-blank.field: Element with a value of spaces only (left out)
5.4-blank.note: Only optional elements whose parent keeps other elements.

5.5.field: Reference id without "/" at the start or end and without "//"

5.6-dbtr.note: Type the IBAN of the debtor account exactly as the bank gives it.

5.6-cdtr.note: Type the IBAN the creditor confirmed. Check digits cannot be guessed.

5.11.note: Check the LEI in the GLEIF database.

6.1.manual: Add the element the CMIplus guideline requires, in the system that creates the file.

6.2-ignored.note: Check that nobody relies on it.

6.3.manual: Remove the extra occurrences, or combine their content, in the system that creates the file.

6.4.field: Text shortened to the length the CMIplus guideline allows

6.5-blocks.manual: Split the payment blocks into several files.

6.5-file.manual: Split the payments into several files.

6.5-block.manual: Split the transactions into several payment blocks.

6.6.manual: Use a currency the bank supports for this payment type, or send the payment as another type.

6.8-currency.note: Or put the transactions of each currency into a block of their own.

6.9-purp.manual: Use a purpose code the bank supports.

6.9-ctgypurp.manual: Use a category purpose code the bank supports.

6.9-svclvl.manual: Use a service level code the bank supports.

6.9-lclinstrm.manual: Use a local instrument code the bank supports.

6.10.manual: Use the initiating party id the bank gave the customer, in the format of the contract.

6.11-accounts.manual: Put the payments of each debtor account into a separate file.

6.11-agents.manual: Put the payments of each debtor bank into a separate file.

6.12-dbtr.field: Ultimate debtor not supported for the payment type (removed)

6.12-cdtr.field: Ultimate creditor not supported for the payment type (removed)

7.1.manual: Send SEPA credit transfers in EUR, or send the payment as a cross-border payment. The currency is not changed here.

7.2.manual: Give the creditor's IBAN, or send a payment to an account outside SEPA as a cross-border payment.

7.3.manual: Use service level SEPA for a SEPA credit transfer, or leave the service level out.

7.4-implicit.field: Charge bearer SLEV (EUR payment within SEPA)
7.4-implicit.note: If the payment must not be sent as a SEPA payment, give a service level instead, in the system that creates the file.

7.5.manual: Send an amount within the SEPA limits, or split the payment. Amounts are not changed here.

7.6-rmt.note: The lines are joined with a space, if they fit into 140 characters.

7.8.manual: Send the address structured: at least town (TwnNm) and country (Ctry) in their own elements.

7.9.manual: Add the debtor's postal address, at least town and country, to the payment block.

7.10.manual: Send SEPA Instant payments in EUR, or send the payment without local instrument INST.

7.11.field: Requested execution date of SEPA Instant payments, set to today
7.11.note: Or send them as SEPA credit transfers without local instrument INST.

7.12.manual: Send a smaller amount, or send the payment as a SEPA credit transfer.

7.13.manual: Send domestic payments in the local currency, or send the payment as a cross-border payment.

7.14.manual: Check the creditor's IBAN: a domestic payment goes to an account in the selected country.

7.15.manual: Use a service level and local instrument of the country's domestic scheme.

7.16.manual: Check whether the payment must be sent as urgent.

7.17.manual: Give the BIC of the creditor's bank, or its clearing member id together with its name and address.

7.18.manual: Send the debtor and creditor addresses structured, with at least town (TwnNm) and country (Ctry).

7.18-missing.manual: Add the postal address, with at least town (TwnNm) and country (Ctry).

7.19.note: SHAR: each side pays its own bank. DEBT: the debtor pays all charges. CRED: the creditor pays all. When both banks are in the EEA and the currency is an EEA currency, only SHAR.

7.20.field: Charge bearer SHAR (both banks in the EEA)

7.21.manual: Give the IBAN for countries that use IBANs; otherwise the account number with letters, digits, spaces, - and / only.

7.22.manual: Add a purpose code (Purp) or regulatory reporting (RgltryRptg) for payments to this country.

7.23.manual: Agree the currency with the creditor.

7.24.manual: Identify each intermediary bank by its BIC, or leave it out.

7.25.field: Text shortened to the length the cross-border format keeps
7.25.note: The first characters are kept, as the cross-border format would keep them.

9.1.note: The first block keeps its id; the others get -2, -3 …

9.2.note: The first transaction keeps its id; the others get -2, -3 …

9.3.note: The first transaction keeps its id; the others get -2, -3 … The creditor sees this reference.

9.4.field: UETR, a new one for the repeated ones
9.4.note: The first transaction keeps its UETR; the others get a new UUID.

9.5.manual: Check whether the payment is in the file twice. If both are wanted, make the remittance information differ.

9.6.manual: Correct the creditor account: a payment cannot go to the account it is paid from.

9.7.field: Debtor name, as in the first block of the same account
9.7.note: Or check that the debtor account is right.

9.10.manual: Leave the ultimate debtor out when the debtor pays for itself.

10.1.field: Requested execution date, moved to the next business day

10.2.manual: Send the file before the cut-off time, or choose a later execution date.

10.3.field: Text shortened to the length CMIplus keeps
10.3.note: The first characters are kept, as CMIplus would keep them.

10.6-lei.manual: Add the LEI of the debtor (Dbtr/Id/OrgId/LEI).

10.6-ultimate.manual: If the payments are made on behalf of another party, name it as the ultimate debtor.

10.7.manual: Move the address lines into the structured address elements.

10.9-transactions.manual: Send the payments in more than one file before the limit is reached.

10.9-blocks.manual: Combine payment blocks or send more than one file before the limit is reached.

10.9-block.manual: Split the payments of this block into more blocks before the limit is reached.

10.10.manual: Check the bank's rules for payments on behalf of others.

X.1.manual: Send the customer's own EndToEndId so that the creditor gets a reference.
